description: Long COVID / PASC population. Key clinical context: U09.9 is the correct ICD-10 for post-acute sequelae, not U07.1 (active COVID). Fatigue, cognitive impairment, and autonomic dysfunction (tachycardia, dyspnea) are hallmark features. No FDA-approved specific treatment exists — symptomatic management (SSRIs, low-dose naltrexone, beta-blockers for POTS) is appropriate.
do_not_flag: Absence of antiviral medications (remdesivir, Paxlovid) — these are for acute COVID, not Long COVID
Resting tachycardia (HR 100-140) in Long COVID patients — autonomic dysfunction and POTS are hallmark features
Low SpO2 (88-94%) during activity in Long COVID — exertional oxygen desaturation is a documented feature
Multiple psychiatric medications in same patient — depression and anxiety are extremely prevalent (40-60%) in Long COVID
Elevated CRP (10-85 mg/L) in Long COVID — persistent low-grade inflammation is a documented mechanism
Elevated ferritin in Long COVID — hyperferritinemia is associated with post-COVID inflammatory state
Low-dose naltrexone use without opioid diagnosis — LDN (4.5 mg) is used off-label as an immunomodulator in Long COVID
Multiple symptomatic complaints (fatigue + dyspnea + cognitive + cardiac) in same patient — multi-system involvement is the defining feature of PASC

U09.9 coded as the sole diagnosis in a follow-up encounter without explicit symptom codes — ICD-10-CM guidelines allow U09.9 to be the primary and only code when the Long COVID condition is the reason for the visit; secondary symptom codes are supplementary, not required

Absence of spirometry data (FEV1/FVC) in Long COVID — spirometry is not part of routine Long COVID management unless significant obstructive disease is suspected; the 15% asthma comorbidity prevalence does not require population-wide spirometry

required_drug_classes.rationale: Depression prevalence in Long COVID is 40-60%. SSRIs appear in most Long COVID clinic treatment protocols.

required_checks: VERIFY that fatigue-related codes (R53.83) or dyspnea (R06.00) appear in at least some patients alongside U09.9 — isolated U09.9 without symptom codes is undercoding. If no symptom codes at all, flag as MEDIUM.
VERIFY that inflammatory labs (CRP, ferritin) appear in the population. If absent, flag as MEDIUM.
